name: RAKwireless WisBlock Starter Kit (RAK4631 + RAK19007)
description: Modular LoRa node: RAK4631 core (nRF52840 + SX1262) on the RAK19007 base with USB-C, LiPo/solar charging and sensor/display slots; BLE 5 plus LoRaWAN for about $25 with antennas.
notes: RAK4631 core module: nRF52840 (64 MHz Cortex-M4F, 1 MB flash, 256 KB RAM), SX1262 LoRa (region-specific: EU868, US915, AU915, KR920, AS923, IN865, RU864) and BLE 5; plugs into a WisBlock Base via a 40-pin connector.
The base (RAK19007) adds USB-C, LiPo charger with solar input, and slots for RAK sensor/display/GPS modules. Needs a LoRa and a BLE antenna connected before use.
Two firmware flavours: Arduino/Meshtastic BSP (RAK4631) and RUI3 AT-command (RAK4631-R). Adafruit UF2 bootloader.
GPIO count and board size are approximate and depend on the chosen base and IO modules; price is for the kit (base + core + antennas + cable).
